# Daleel (دليل)

> Saudi DGA (Digital Government Authority) design-system readiness scanner.

Daleel (formerly dls-check) is a report-only CLI + MCP server (part of Otto, dev.ottospace.co)
that scans a codebase for Saudi DGA compliance — RTL-first, IBM Plex Sans Arabic, WCAG 2.1 AA — a
legal requirement for Saudi government digital services. Detection is AST-verified (Babel for
JS/TS/JSX, PostCSS for CSS), so utilities inside comments, strings and identifiers are never
mis-flagged. It flags physical CSS/Tailwind (incl. variant-prefixed like md:/hover:/rtl:, space-x,
inset, corners, arbitrary values) + hard-coded dir="ltr"/direction:ltr (RTL), font stacks that name
a font but not IBM Plex Sans Arabic (FONT), missing alt / html lang (A11Y), and prints the manual
checklist for tokens/components/contrast/keyboard/parity. Daleel never edits your source.

## Use it
- CLI: `npx github:moradothmanepro-OTTO/dls-check .` (bin: `daleel`, alias `dls-check`)
- MCP: run `daleel-mcp` (tools: daleel_scan, daleel_check_code; aliases dls_scan, dls_check_code)
- Suppress: `// daleel-ignore` · Config: `.daleelrc.json` ({ fonts, ignore, disable })

Links: https://github.com/moradothmanepro-OTTO/dls-check · https://dev.ottospace.co
